dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, if you lived in Canada, what would you miss most?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪf juː ˈlɪvd ɪn ˈkænədə, ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈmɪs ˈmoʊst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Definitely my family. And Thai food!
dialogue.reading: ˈdɛfənətli maɪ ˈfæməli. ənd ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But wouldn't you enjoy the freedom?
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈwʊdənt juː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈfriːdəm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. If I lived far from my parents, I'd have to be more independent.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ɪf aɪ ˈlɪvd ˈfɑːr frəm maɪ ˈpɛrənts, aɪd ˈhæf tə bi ˈmɔːr ˌɪndɪˈpɛndənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a good thing. When I came to Thailand, I took a big risk.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈθɪŋ. wɛn aɪ ˈkeɪm tə ˈtaɪlænd, aɪ ˈtʊk ə ˈbɪɡ ˈrɪsk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A little. But it was the best decision of my life.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ɪt wʌz ðə ˈbɛst dɪˈsɪʒən əv maɪ ˈlaɪf.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I had more money, I'd take a risk and pursue my dreams abroad for a few years.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ ˈhæd ˈmɔːr ˈmʌni, aɪd ˈteɪk ə ˈrɪsk ənd pərˈsuː maɪ ˈdriːmz əˈbrɔːd fər ə ˈfjuː ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And would you settle down there, or come back to Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ənd wʊd juː ˈsɛtəl ˈdaʊn ˈðɛr, ɔːr ˈkʌm ˈbæk tə ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd come back one day. If I settled down far from my family, I'd feel lonely.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈkʌm ˈbæk ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ. ɪf aɪ ˈsɛtəld ˈdaʊn ˈfɑːr frəm maɪ ˈfæməli, aɪd ˈfiːl ˈloʊnli.
